runtime/bigint#

The native layer under numbers/bigint: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under numbers/bigint: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime. The arithmetic natives were removed in #13: BigInt arithmetic is the builtin's (#511).

Public API#

native bigint_valid#

native bigint_valid(origin is string) is bool

Portable arbitrary-precision integer value boundary.

native bigint_bits#

native bigint_bits(origin is string) is int

How many bits the magnitude takes.
